newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Korean French Banking closes $60mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Korean French Banking closes $60mln FRCD.

text.p: Korean French Banking Corp's US$60 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue due 2001 was successfully closed, lead manager Fuji International Finance (HK) said on Monday.
The certificates mature in five years with a put and a call option in year three. They were issued at par to float at 50 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 62 basis points.

Lead managers are Bank Austria and Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur Singapore branch with US$8 million each, Fuji International Finance (HK) with US$6 million, and Bankgesellschaft Berlin Group and KDB International (Singapore) with US$5 million each.
Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Creditanstalt-Bankverein Vienna, Den Danske Bank Hong Kong branch, GiroCredit Bank and Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz Girozentrale.
Managers are Baden-Wurttembergische Bank and Vereins-und Westbank, with US$3 million each, and Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA Singapore branch, with US$2 million.
Signing is set for December 16. Payment date is December 30.
